adaptations: Relative imports and explicit grid defaults; numerical MPC, local JPS and dynamics retained. Planner warmup compiles both contiguous and noncontiguous windows before worker readiness.
Upstream robot_jps.py corridor seeding, corridor selection and stop-plan fallback adapted to measured ROS states and persistent parallel workers.
Fixed-altitude 3D flight, Iris physical limits, ROS perception, mapping, formation and supervision retained.
Corridor margin includes occupied-cell quantization and three standard deviations of the configured Gaussian LiDAR noise.
Stop-plan replay follows simulation time and requires measured position, velocity and acceleration agreement; failures remain visible to mission supervision.

2026-10-20: Restored upstream distance-gated per-UAV modes, leader/assignment hysteresis, predictive contraction, path carrots, moving slots, travel-time pursuit and target filter covariance; see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#verification-and-optimizer-replay.
Coherent elapsed-time/reanchored six-state neighbor snapshots, responsive asynchronous ROS cycles, source-stamped expiry and measured-state fallback validation are intentional physical adaptations.
Runtime CPU/worker caps retained; direct read-only upstream parity uses iteration-only reference settings. Bounded complete optimizer input and backup-warm-start capture added for future replay.

2026-10-29: Solver and predictive dynamics now execute directly from the unchanged pinned submodule. Inactive-neighbor conditioning and optional speed recovery remain in a local adapter; planning, mapping and coordination remain local ports.

2026-11-07: Baseline algorithm 'apf' executes unchanged upstream apf.py (with apfc.py speed_limit and dynamics.py) per UAV through the shared fleet runtime. Local adapters supply measured-state robot shims, latest-scan LiDAR hit obstacles, the upstream leader standoff goal and a one-step command rollout that brakes to rest (upstream impc_ob braking rule).

2026-11-07: Baselines 'cbf_qp' and 'cbf_qp_lag' execute unchanged upstream cbfqp.py (lag_aware False/True, with apfc.py speed_limit and dynamics.py) per UAV through the shared fleet runtime. Guidance supplies the target filter velocity as the PD feed-forward. Infeasible-QP hybrid braking is reported as a visible fallback (cbf_infeasible_brake) using upstream's counters. Robot shims, latest-scan obstacles, the leader standoff goal and the command rollout are shared with apf.

2026-11-07: Baseline 'pure_mpc' executes unchanged upstream pure_mpc.py (PureMPC, with dynamics.py) per UAV through the shared fleet runtime, robot shims, latest-scan obstacles and leader standoff goal. The solved plan Xp/Up is executed directly; a failed solve replays the shared simulation-time stop plan (measured-state checked, extended by braking to the horizon), else brakes, and is reported as a visible fallback.

2026-11-07: Baseline 'impc_ob_rec' executes unchanged upstream impc_ob.py (IMPCOB with recover=True, IMPCOBProblem, with dynamics.py) per UAV through the shared fleet runtime, robot shims, latest-scan obstacles, local committed JPS path and leader standoff goal. The solver problem is built at the upstream maximum of 24 faces with a warm-up solve before readiness. The predetermined trajectory is the previous executed plan aligned by elapsed simulation time; teammate priority/distance/contest come from the previous cycle through the fleet broadcast channel; slot look-ahead follows the leader's current velocity. IMPC_EPSILON/IMPC_BUFFER derive from L = UAV_SAFE_DISTANCE / 0.6. A failed step replays the simulation-time stop plan while it keeps CORRIDOR_MARGIN - IMPC_BUFFER from the current scan (upstream _tail_collides), else brakes with upstream _brake_traj, as visible fallbacks.
solver_integration: Unchanged submodule runtime_sources loaded lazily per algorithm by core/upstream.py: mpc_problem.py and dynamics.py for mpc (core/algorithms/mpc/problem.py applies local compatibility adjustments); apf.py, apfc.py and dynamics.py for apf (core/algorithms/apf/ with the shared core/algorithms/ baseline adapters); cbfqp.py, apfc.py and dynamics.py for cbf_qp and cbf_qp_lag (core/algorithms/cbf_qp/, cbf_qp_lag/); pure_mpc.py and dynamics.py for pure_mpc (core/algorithms/pure_mpc/); impc_ob.py and dynamics.py for impc_ob_rec (core/algorithms/impc_ob_rec/).
